news.title: University of Minnesota researchers receive funding through Great Lakes ReNEW to advance pressing water challenges
news.summary_en: University of Minnesota Twin Cities researchers have received over $325,000 in funding over the next two years through Great Lakes RENEW, a National Science Foundation (NSF) Regional Innovation Engine led by Chicago-based water innovation hub Current, to develop methods of recycling cooling water for data centers and detecting and removing contaminants from wastewater.
